name: A Grand Adventure
summary: In Valanaar, Elaadrin Evengale asks you to hear the High Order’s plans. Their search for ancient magic may shape Zephras Isle’s future.

sections.title: A Lost Heritage
sections.body: Elaadrin speaks of your Highborne lineage and the young people who may help save their home. The High Order seeks the ancient magic of its forebears, and what has been lost over many millennia.

sections.title: The Way Ahead
sections.body: Elaadrin says Azeroth is key to the search. The Kirin Tor will show the High Order the way. As its members prepare to leave, you can speak with others in Valanaar. Many need help with their work.

faq.q: Who is asking me to listen?
faq.answer: Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar asks you to hear the High Order’s plans.

faq.q: What is the High Order trying to rediscover?
faq.answer: The High Order seeks its forebears’ ancient magic and what was lost over many millennia.

faq.q: Why does the High Order seek ancient magic?
faq.answer: Elaadrin says rediscovering ancient magic is key to unlocking Zephras Isle’s secrets and securing its future.

faq.q: Who will show them the way?
faq.answer: Elaadrin says the Kirin Tor will show the High Order the way.

faq.q: What can I do while they prepare to leave?
faq.answer: While they prepare to leave, you can speak with other members of the High Order in Valanaar. Most need help with their work.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Grand Adventure
